name: Full Smile
verdict: The biggest movement is a 66.67% drop in leads over the last 7 days, which drove CPL up 179.4%, likely caused by ad fatigue or audience saturation on Meta (the sole active channel), where the top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" is carrying $370.69 of the $699.98 28-day spend. GHL shows 85 opportunities created against 86 Meta-reported leads, which are reconciled as both_active, but 0 opportunities won signals a conversion pipeline issue worth investigating.

performance.verdict: Lead collapse is confirmed creative fatigue, but 0 GHL wins is the real crisis.

findings.text: CPL spiked +179.4% in 7d as leads fell 66.67% on near-flat spend (-6.87%); series shows 0 leads on Sep 11–13 — confirmed 3-day drought.
5 overdue SOW milestones (earliest Jul 23): dashboard not live, attribution gap open, sync cleanup pending — August scoreboard untrusted, renewal at risk.
GHL shows 85 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — leads are arriving but pipeline is producing nothing; intake conversion is broken, not ads.
BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness carries $370.69 of $699.98 28-day spend while leads collapse — flat-budget + falling results pattern matches creative fatigue.
GBP generated 80 calls and 252 actions in 28 days — organic floor is holding while paid collapses, suggesting brand demand exists but paid creative is exhausted.

suggestions.text: Introduce new Meta creative into BWS campaign; existing assets drove 0 leads over 3 days on $37.85 spend Sep 12–14.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign produced 0 leads across Sep 11–13 while spending ~$37.85, a confirmed 3-day drought signalling creative exhaustion. Launch at least 2 new ad variants (new hook, new visual) into the existing campaign without changing budget or audience. Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $8.14 within 7 days (by Sep 22). If CPL remains above $15 after 7 days, escalate to audience or offer review.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL pipeline: 85 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm intake process is actively working leads.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL records 85 opportunities and 0 appointments won in the 28-day window — leads are entering the system but not being contacted or scheduled. Audit the intake workflow with Lily: confirm GHL notifications are firing, call attempts are logged, and the new intake hire is actioning leads. Success check: at least 5 appointments booked and visible in GHL within 7 days (by Sep 22). This is an intake operations issue, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Watch all 5 overdue SOW milestones; dashboard must be live before renewal decision — re-check Sep 22.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue, the oldest from Jul 23, including the August scoreboard dashboard and attribution gap closure — both are explicit renewal blockers per the client's stated criteria. No paid action is appropriate until the dashboard is live and the scoreboard is trusted. Re-check all milestone statuses on Sep 22 and escalate to Sohib and Nacer immediately if the dashboard remains undelivered.
